question: Can category-specific state/action projections also use NVFP4 while the same QAD/OPD recovery scope preserves LIBERO behavior?

development.purpose: select the category-aware pressure recipe and recovery settings before final evaluation

collection.purpose: collect student-visited observations for the frozen QAD checkpoint

heldout.purpose: single final paired read after all category-aware choices are frozen

smoke.purpose: fixture and server validation only; never a reported score

fixed_runtime.settle_action: seven raw simulator zeros including gripper; outside policy horizon
fixed_runtime.paired_scope: environment initial-state hashes; policy noise is seeded per task, not per episode

selection.qad_learning_rate_tie_break: If development macro success is equal, choose the lower learning rate.
selection.opd_weight_tie_break: If development macro success is equal, choose the lower OPD weight.
selection.rule: Evaluate both category-aware pressure candidates. Freeze the highest-FP4 candidate whose development macro success is at least 0.20 below BF16 and at least 0.30 absolute. If neither qualifies, report that the pre-registered pressure window was not reached rather than changing the threshold. Choose QAD/OPD settings only from development results.

category_quantization.method: active category uses calibrated GPTQ when its weighted error beats RTN; unobserved categories use RTN and are explicitly marked
category_quantization.axis_contract: source [category,K,N] is transposed to [N,K], padded only along K to a multiple of 16, quantized, cropped, and transposed back

primary: NVFP4 share of eligible and all checkpoint parameters
target encoding budget including the BF16 low-rank residual
reporting.heldout_freeze: No heldout result may select a recipe, teacher weight, training length, checkpoint, or statistical test.
